# Organic Dark Rye Flour

Bake hearty rye bread or add robust flavor to cookies, crackers, and quick breads with Organic Dark Rye Flour. Freshly stone-ground from USDA Certified Organic U.S. #1 rye berries, it's a 100% whole grain flour with all the nutrients of the bran and germ.

Bob's Red Mill Dark Rye Flour is 100% stone-ground from premium organic U.S. #1 dark, plump rye berries, preserving all the nutrients of the bran, germ and endosperm. Its deep, hearty flavor has made rye a staple throughout history, and it remains a cornerstone of Eastern European and Scandinavian baking, where it can withstand the colder climates better than other grains.

Bake hearty rye bread or add robust flavor to cookies, crackers, and quick breads with Organic Dark Rye Flour. Freshly stone-ground from USDA Certified Organic U.S. #1 rye berries, it's a 100% whole grain flour with all the nutrients of the bran and germ.

Rye is rich in dietary fiber and iron and provides antioxidants and essential nutrients such as selenium, phosphorus, magnesium, copper, zinc and protein.

Add Dark Rye Flour to your baked goods for a distinctive, robust flavor. It’s perfect for hearty peasant-style rye bread and works beautifully in everything from pancakes and waffles to cookies, crackers, quick breads, stollen, cakes, pie crust and even pizza dough.
